decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line belongs to the core garage door business, is cheap to keep, and nothing reported since 2019 shows its value failing to materialize.
The remote-control operator still complements the range at low cost, though it may be folded into the broader operator line, so its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher.
Demand for thermally insulated industrial doors keeps rising with energy-efficiency requirements, so the option retains value and costs little to hold.
After its sibling glazed door D was dropped, F remains the consolidated glazed offering with its own page, and there is no evidence warranting abandonment.
